name: Simultaneous Yaniv: Claims
summary: Low-hand card game played in simultaneous turns: each round players secretly call or discard, then secretly claim another player's discarded card or take a shared blind draw. A caller who is not strictly lowest is caught (Asaf) for +30, and the lowest total when someone reaches 150 or after 40 rounds wins.

player.meaning: Card values the player holds (0 to 10). Revealed to all at a showdown.
Sum of the values in hand.
Points scored at the latest showdown.
This round's secret first choice: CALL, a list of discarded values, or NONE.
Whether the player called this round. Revealed at the showdown.
Values discarded this round. Announced at the offers step.
This round's second choice: BLIND or an offer id. Made secretly and announced in the public result.
Whether this round's claim was lost to a contest.
Whether the player received the blind card this round.

game.meaning: Card source. Every draw picks a value at random and does not remove it (reshuffled before every draw).
Number of players who called this round.
L, the lowest hand sum at a showdown.
Offered cards this round, each 'seat S: value V'.
Value of this round's blind card. Each BLIND player gets a copy and is told the value privately.
Previous round's public results: discards, claims, failed claims, BLIND takers, or the showdown outcome.

setup: Every player's total is set to 0 and round is set to 1.
The shoe holds 54 values: two 0s, four each of 1 to 9, and sixteen 10s.
Each player is dealt 5 cards. Each card is a value drawn at random from the shoe without removing it, appended to that player's hand.
Each player's hand_sum and hand_size are computed. hand_size is public and the hand is private.

round.effect: Announce round, every player's hand_size and total, and last_results.
Each player privately sees their own hand and hand_sum.

round.answer: CALL, or the list of card values from own hand to discard (one card, two or more equal values, or a run of 3 or more consecutive values). A 1-card player with hand_sum <= 7 is offered only CALL. A 1-card player with hand_sum > 7 is offered only NONE.
round.effect: first_choice := the answer.

Any illegal first_choice is replaced: a player with hand_size >= 2 discards their single highest card; a player with hand_size 1 discards nothing (NONE). Then called := (first_choice == CALL), and called_count := the number of players with called true.
round.judged: This player's first choice is legal: CALL with hand_sum at most 7; or values all held in their hand that form a single card, two or more cards of equal value, or a run of three or more consecutive values with no 0 and at most one 10; and at least one card is left in hand.

round.effect: When called_count >= 1 (showdown): all discards are cancelled and lowest_sum := the minimum hand_sum. For each player: if called and hand_sum == lowest_sum and the count of players with hand_sum == lowest_sum is 1, round_score := 0; else if called, round_score := hand_sum + 30; else if hand_sum == lowest_sum, round_score := 0; else round_score := hand_sum. total += round_score. last_results records the revealed hands, the callers and the scores.
When called_count >= 1: reveal every hand, hand_sum, called, round_score and total.
When called_count >= 1: end the game if any total >= 150 or round == 40.
When called_count >= 1 and round < 40: each hand is cleared and gets 5 random draws from the shoe (without removal). hand_sum and hand_size are recomputed.

When called_count == 0: discard := the discarded values, which are removed from hand; hand_sum and hand_size are recomputed. offers := for each player who discarded one card or an equal-value set, one entry 'seat S: value V'; for each player who discarded a run, two entries, its lowest and its highest value. A player who discarded nothing makes no offer.
When called_count == 0: announce every player's discard and the offers list.

round.answer: BLIND, or one entry of offers that belongs to another seat.
round.effect: When called_count == 0: claim := the answer. An illegal answer becomes BLIND.
When called_count == 0 (contests): for each offer entry claimed by 2 or more players, each of those players gets claim_failed := true and claim := BLIND. took_blind := (claim == BLIND).

When called_count == 0: blind_card := one value drawn at random from the shoe (without removal). Each player whose claim is an offer appends that offer's value to hand. Each player with took_blind appends blind_card to hand. hand_sum and hand_size are recomputed.
When called_count == 0: privately tell the player the value of blind_card.
When called_count == 0: last_results := who claimed which card, which claims failed through contest, and who took BLIND. The blind_card value is not included.
When called_count == 0: announce last_results.

When round == 40 and called_count == 0 (final showdown): lowest_sum := the minimum hand_sum. Each player gets round_score := 0 if hand_sum == lowest_sum, else round_score := hand_sum. total += round_score.
When round == 40 and called_count == 0: reveal every hand, hand_sum, round_score and total.
Reset called, discard, claim, claim_failed, took_blind and offers. round += 1.
End the game if any total >= 150 or round > 40.

ending.condition: any player's total >= 150 after a showdown, or round > 40 (after round 40 is played)
ending.decided_by: The player with the lowest total wins. Players level at the lowest total share the result (the source calls this a draw).

rules.text: Card values: Ace = 1, 2 to 10 = face value, J/Q/K = 10, Joker = 0. Every draw is a random value from a 54-card shoe (two 0s, four each of 1 to 9, sixteen 10s), reshuffled before each draw.
Before round 1, each player is dealt 5 cards and every total is 0.
When a player's hand_sum is 7 or less, then CALL is a legal first choice; when it is 8 or more, CALL is illegal.
When a player discards, then the discard is exactly one card, two or more cards of equal value, or a run of 3 or more consecutive values.
When a run contains a 0 or more than one 10, then it is illegal; 8-9-10 is legal and 9-10-10 is not.
When a discard would leave 0 cards in hand, then it is illegal.
When a player holds 1 card and hand_sum <= 7, then that player must CALL; when they hold 1 card and hand_sum > 7, then they discard nothing and still make the second choice.
When a first choice is illegal, then it is replaced by discarding the single highest card, or by discarding nothing for a player with 1 card.
When at least one player calls, then all discards are cancelled and a showdown is held on the hands as they stood.
At a showdown, when a caller's hand_sum is strictly lower than every other player's, then that caller scores 0.
At a showdown, when a caller is not strictly lowest, then the caller is caught (Asaf) and scores hand_sum + 30 (a caller with sum 6 tied at 6 scores 36).
At a showdown, when a non-caller's hand_sum equals the lowest sum L, then they score 0; otherwise they score their hand_sum.
After a showdown, when no total is 150 or more and the round is not 40, then every player is dealt a fresh hand of 5 cards, and steps 5 to 10 are skipped.
When no one calls, then every discard is announced publicly and leaves play.
When a single card or an equal-value set is discarded, then it makes one offer of that value; when a run is discarded, then it makes two offers, its lowest and its highest value.
When no one calls, then each player chooses BLIND or a claim on one offered card of another player; claiming one's own offer is illegal and becomes BLIND.
When two or more players claim the same offered card, then none of them receives it and each is treated as BLIND.
When exactly one player claims an offered card, then that card is added to that player's hand.
When no one calls, then one blind card is drawn, and each BLIND player adds a copy of it to their hand and is privately told its value.
When the public result is announced, then it names who claimed which card, which claims failed through contest, and who took BLIND, but not the blind card's value.
When round 40 ends with no showdown that round, then all hands are revealed, each player at the lowest sum scores 0 and every other player scores their hand_sum.
When any total is 150 or more after a showdown, or round 40 is over, then the game ends.
When the game ends, then the player with the strictly lowest total wins; when two or more tie for lowest, then the game is a draw (shared result).

offers.question: First choice (step 3)
offers.options: A player with 2 or more cards and hand_sum <= 7: CALL, or any legal discard from their hand (one card, an equal-value set of 2 or more, or a run of 3 or more consecutive values with no 0 and at most one 10), keeping at least 1 card. A player with 2 or more cards and hand_sum > 7: any such legal discard only. A player with 1 card and hand_sum <= 7: CALL only. A player with 1 card and hand_sum > 7: NONE only.

offers.question: Second choice (step 6)
offers.who: all players, including those who discarded nothing
offers.options: BLIND, or any entry of offers that belongs to a seat other than their own.

choices.why: 4 is the designer's size and is kept. Three is the minimum for contests over offered cards and for a caller to face more than one rival. More than five makes contests near-certain and the showdown arithmetic too long to follow.
The source has no talk. Strategy lies in reading discards and claims (claiming a card reveals what you hold), timing the call, and avoiding contested claims.

choices.what: A 1-card player is offered only the forced option
choices.why: The rules force CALL (if allowed) or discarding nothing, so no other option is offered.

choices.what: Draws are with replacement from a 54-value list
choices.why: The source reshuffles the shoe before every draw, so the shoe's frequencies never change.

choices.what: Each card of a run's two offers is claimable separately
choices.why: The rules call each one an offered card that a player may claim.

simplifications.what: The legality of a discard (set or run) is judged by a referee sentence
simplifications.why: Checking that values are held and form a set or a valid run is list logic, beyond simple arithmetic. Scoring stays arithmetic.

simplifications.what: A tie for the lowest total is a shared win rather than a declared draw
simplifications.why: The engine shares the win among players level at the top. This is the same outcome as the source's draw.

simplifications.what: The lowest total wins via rank_by = -total
simplifications.why: The engine ranks the highest value first.
